headline: Bank of Baroda posts record Q2 profit as asset quality improves

Operating profit surged 50.9% to ₹11,430 crore, while global business expanded 17.2% to ₹32.58 lakh crore. Asset quality improved as the gross NPA ratio fell to 1.78% and net NPA dropped to 0.37%. However, provisions jumped 93% during the quarter.
